Definition: Integration with national payment systems for government-to-person (G2P), government-to-business (G2B) transactions via data exchange
Comments: UNDP Compass scores Payments at 0 (Stage 1: cash/checks dominate). National banking switch is largely defunct. Bank of Khartoum Bankak app is a dominant digital transaction channel but concentration on single provider. No G2P payment integration via data exchange.

Definition: Whether primary laws, acts, or legal instruments exist that establish authority for cross-government data sharing and govern the data exchange system
Comments: No comprehensive law governing cross-government data sharing. Electronic Transactions Act 2007 and Cybercrime Acts exist. No dedicated data protection law. Three new digital authorities created by PM decree in Nov 2025 but no legislative basis for data exchange.

Definition: Whether a formal strategy or policy document exists specifically for government data exchange and interoperability
Comments: Ministry of Digital Transformation and Communications established (March 2021). Three digital authorities created by decree Nov 2025 (Digital Transformation Authority, Data and AI Authority, Cybersecurity Authority). Aspirations for unified digital system stated. World Bank DE4A diagnostic (2022) noted scattered, siloed approach to digital platforms. UNDP scores leadership and strategy at 2.08 (Stage 3).

Definition: Current operational status of the data exchange system
Comments: Sudan's national interoperability switch is largely defunct due to ongoing armed conflict since April 2023. Pre-war, there was a national banking switch for interoperability among banks, but it was limited. UNDP Digital Development Compass scores Sudan's data exchange at 1.43 (Stage 2 Opportunistic: siloed, limited exchange). Digital infrastructure has been severely damaged.

Definition: Extent to which the data exchange enables services accessible to all population groups including persons with disabilities, elderly, low literacy
Comments: UNDP Digital Development Compass scores Sudan's Digital Public Services at 0.81 (Stage 1: paper-based, no online services). EGDI 2024 score 0.2759, below African average. Conflict has severely degraded access.

Definition: Provisions ensuring national control over government data and protecting against unauthorized foreign access
Comments: No data protection legislation. UNDP Compass Data and Privacy at 2.92 (functional data protection authority/regulation in recognition stage), but in practice no laws restricting cross-border data transfer. Electronic Transactions Act 2007 and Cybercrime Acts exist but do not address data sovereignty comprehensively.

Definition: Extent to which provincial/state and local governments participate in the data exchange
Comments: Study of 18 local government websites found e-government at early stages with no integration or interoperability between institutions. Conflict has further disrupted sub-national digital capacity.

Comments: UNDP Compass notes physical infrastructure at Stage 2 (inaccessible, basic quality, selective coverage). World Bank 2022 diagnostic notes skewed geographic concentration of digital infrastructure. Conflict has worsened this divide.
